host_attention.counts: distinct outside addresses, today, with a finding nothing has decided on or whose latest decision leaves it to a person (the AI wanted a person to confirm, escalated it or parked it for review, a person reopened it, a containment was not carried out, or the decision is one this count cannot place); research-only, internal and allowlisted traffic set aside, and an address something that day blocked or sent to the honeypot not counted
host_attention.findings_waiting_off_the_line_counts: host findings from today that wait in Cases and that a count of addresses cannot include, one per finding: a finding whose latest decision leaves it to a person, a high or critical one nothing has decided on, and a critical one, or one of a kind the product never closes on its own (a rootkit, kernel tampering, a reverse shell and the like), that no person has answered and no containment the record stands behind has closed. A count of addresses cannot include a finding that names no outside address (only private ones, the host's own, a cloud provider's the host talks through, or none at all), one on an allowlisted address or on one already blocked for another finding that day, one from a detector that only advises, one about a process of the host's own (InnerWarden or a system daemon), or one kept for research only
